title: Legacy Business Insights Workflow Automation: SaaS application tenants and ServiceNow setup

prose.text: The validation error codes are listed for ZIA tenants in [[zia.casb.tenants]], and whether they apply to a Validation Failed tenant here is open {{gap:validation-error-codes}}. Roles that grant Workflow Automation are in [[business-insights.legacy.admin]]; the area hub is [[business-insights.legacy]].

tenant-statuses.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, A SaaS Application Tenant status is Active (in use), Inactive (not in use), Validation Failed (admin credentials or authorization could not be validated) or Reauthorization Required (edit the tenant and click Reauthorize).

quotes: Active: The tenant is in use.
Inactive: The tenant is not in use.
Validation Failed: There were issues validating the admin credentials and authorizing the SaaS application.
Reauthorization Required: Edit the tenant, and click Reauthorize to log in to the SaaS application and give Zscaler access to it.

tenant-owner-policy.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, The tenant list shows an Owner (created in ZIA or Digital Experience) and the SaaS Security Data At Rest Scanning policies (DLP and Malware Detection) configured for the tenant.

quotes: Owner: Indicates whether the SaaS application tenant was created in Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) or Digital Experience (ZDX).
Policy Configured: The SaaS Security Data At Rest Scanning policies (DLP and Malware Detection) configured for the SaaS application tenant.

tenant-purpose.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Workflow Automation tenants let, for example, a ServiceNow tenant create, manage and track tickets for inactive users observed via scheduled reports.

quotes: The integration of SaaS applications with Workflow Automation for the Business Insights service helps to align your organization's workflows.
you can integrate a ServiceNow tenant to create, manage, and track tickets for inactive users observed via scheduled reports.

integration-enable.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, A SaaS application is integrated with Workflow Automation either by adding it or by ensuring Workflow Automation is enabled for an already added application, which is done by selecting the Workflow Automation checkbox at Administration > Workflow Integration.

quotes: - Add the SaaS application or
- Ensure Workflow Automation is enabled for an already added application
1. Go to Administration > Workflow Integration.
3. Select the Workflow Automation checkbox.

tenant-name-unique.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, A SaaS application tenant name for Workflow Automation must be unique.

quotes: enter a name for the SaaS application tenant. It must be unique.

servicenow-prerequisites.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Configuring ServiceNow as a Workflow Automation tenant requires a ServiceNow user account with an admin role, the OAuth 2.0 plugin installed and active, and the com.snc.platform.security.oauth.is.active property set to true.

quotes: To configure ServiceNow as a tenant, you must have a ServiceNow user account with an admin role.
Verify the OAuth 2.0 plugin is active.
Ensure that the Value column for the com.snc.platform.security.oauth.is.active property is true.
If the plugin isn't installed, click Install and then Activate.

servicenow-token-lifespans.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, In the ServiceNow OAuth client for a Workflow Automation tenant, the Refresh Token Lifespan defaults to 8,640,000 seconds (100 days) and the Access Token Lifespan to 1,800 seconds (30 minutes), and Zscaler recommends larger values such as 157,700,000 seconds (5 years) and 86,400 seconds (24 hours).

quotes: To configure an OAuth client application:
Refresh Token Lifespan: The default lifespan is 8,640,000 seconds (100 days). Zscaler recommends changing it to a larger value, such as 157,700,000 seconds (5 years)
Access Token Lifespan: The default value is 1,800 seconds (30 minutes). Zscaler recommends changing it to a larger value, such as 86,400 seconds (24 hours).

servicenow-refresh-reconfigure.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, After the ServiceNow refresh token expires, ServiceNow must be configured as a new tenant.

quotes: because you'll need to configure ServiceNow as a new tenant after the refresh token expires.

validation-error-codes.title: Whether the SaaS application validation error codes apply to a legacy Business Insights tenant
validation-error-codes.detail: A tenant can show the Validation Failed status, and the legacy articles refer to a page of SaaS Application Validation Error Codes. A same-titled capture, zia-saas-application-validation-error-codes.json, is cited by the validation-error-codes claim of zia.casb.tenants and lists the codes; the legacy articles do not show that their link points to that page or that its codes are what a Business Insights tenant reports.
